prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it, otherwise scan area. If close, grab it, check properties and perform specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
